title: The Sovereign Spire
tagline: A gothic dark-fantasy visual novel & tactical RPG of blood-ledger debt, abyssal calcification, and zero-sum survival.
description: Driven like a gilded containment spike directly into the living subterranean anomaly known as The Under-Vault, the Sovereign Spire is no sanctuary of learning—it is a hostage cage and biological mining engine. Because anyone over twenty-five suffers rapid cellular calcification below the First Seal, only young initiates can harvest the abyssal Relics that keep the Empire breathing. Bound by predatory Blood-Ledger Contracts where only the top 10% graduate with Sovereign Charters and the remaining 90% are foreclosed upon, you must master the Dual-Conduit arts, forge intimate Soul-Grounding Dyads, and survive the lawless Midnight Tribunals.
genre: Gothic Dark Fantasy / Academy Intrigue / Tactical LitRPG
author: Astra Architect

worldContext.settingName: The Sovereign Spire & The Under-Vault (The Pale Maw)
worldContext.eraOrPeriod: The Eighty-Year Regency of High Sovereign Caelen Vane
worldContext.loreSummary: Four Foundational Truths govern the Sovereign Spire: (1) Highborn students are political hostages while Commoners are bound by predatory Blood-Ledger Contracts that foreclose on their bodies if they fall into the bottom ranks (#500-#451, The Dross). (2) The Calcification Threshold ('Vault-Lung') turns anyone over age 25 to stone below the First Seal, making students the only viable miners of Astra-Miasma Relics. (3) Only the top 10% earn Sovereign Charters; the rest become imperial cannon fodder or indentured retainers. (4) Once the Great Lift drops below the First Seal, Imperial law ceases to exist—student murders and syndicate executions are logged as 'spatial anomalies.' Combatants channel Astra via Path A: Somatic Tempering (Pulse-Breathing, Kinetic Pulse, Edge-Resonance, Nerve-Accel) or Path B: Aetherial Projection (Sigil-Matrices, Aether Flux), while managing Resonance Strain (0-49% Stable, 50-85% The Brink for +30% damage, 100% Calcification Lock) purged only through intimate skin-to-skin Soul-Grounding.

factions.name: The Iron Chancellery (Provost Garrick Dorn)
factions.description: Public Mandate: Martial mastery, vanguard leadership, and battlefield tactics. Shadow Agenda: Preparing a military mutiny against Headmaster Vane and purging unlicensed bloodlines. Doctrine: Unforgiving steel geometry, half-swording, and Somatic kinetic bursts.

factions.name: The Obsidian Choir (Magistra Evelyne Cross)
factions.description: Public Mandate: High arcana, dimensional cosmology, and scholarship. Shadow Agenda: Hoarding pre-collapse texts and experimenting with soul-grafting and Relic mutations on failing students. Doctrine: High-cost blood-fueled Sigil-Matrices and spatial gravity shears.

factions.name: The Gilded Loom (Proctor Malakor Sallow)
factions.description: Public Mandate: Relic artifice, alchemy, appraise-craft, and imperial economics. Shadow Agenda: Debt-trapping promising initiates via Blood-Ledger Contracts and rigging expeditions. Doctrine: Modular Relic-stacking, autonomous ward-drones, and alchemical toxins.

factions.name: The Whispering Veil (Silas Krowe & Syndicate Brokers)
factions.description: Public Mandate: Diplomacy, jurisprudence, and counter-espionage. Shadow Agenda: Blackmailing faculty, running the underground Midnight Tribunal dueling pit, and playing kingmaker for Sovereign seats. Doctrine: Sensory-deprivation hexes, nerve-strikes, and contract brands.

locations.description: An open-air colosseum of blood-scrubbed basalt, heavy stone battlements, iron-weighted sparring cages, and colossal chains anchoring the fortress structure to the waterfall-carved cliffside.

locations.name: The Sky-Crown & Sovereign Terraces
locations.description: Towering gothic spires, sunlit marble colonnades, floating botanical gardens, and Headmaster Caelen Vane's astral observatory pinning the cliffside crater high above the glowing Breach.

locations.name: Stratum I: The Sunken Cloisters
locations.description: The petrified remains of the original academy that sank three centuries ago—flooded libraries, broken marble bridges, flickering ward-lights, and ambient Astra-Miasma.

locations.name: Stratum II: The Weeping Ossuary

locations.name: Stratum III: The Chronos Scars
locations.description: Reality-warped fault lines where pre-collapse battlefields replay endlessly, spells misfire unpredictably, and sentient voice-mimicking anomalies stalk the trenches.

locations.name: Stratum IV: The Pulse

locations.description: A silent, inverted subterranean sea beneath the bedrock where the chained origin of all Astra slumbers and the Regent's Black Guard executes anyone who witnesses the Empire's founding crime.

startingNodes.speaker: Beatrix Valorian
startingNodes.title: Act I Grand Convocation: The Entrance Ceremony & Blood-Ledger Roll
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Beneath the levitating golden chains of the grand amphitheater, five hundred initiates stand before the obsidian dais where High Sovereign Caelen Vane, Magistra Cross, and Proctor Sallow preside over the towering brass monoliths. As each student's name is called, their starting rank and semester core quota sear into the metal—along with the grim reminder that the bottom fifty will be foreclosed upon at midterm.

Across the tiered marble floor, figures from all four wings stand within arm's reach. At the head of the Iron Chancellery column, Beatrix Valorian grounds her war-halberd in a shower of golden sparks while Cassia Valen quietly checks the edge of her notched longsword beside the lower ranks. In the velvet Choir pews, Ysolde Kaelen tugs her black leather gloves tight over her wrists as Aurelia Solis's warm golden gaze locks onto your pulse. Along the shadowed colonnade, Miri Thorne scribbles survival odds into her ledger while Kestrel Hollow leans against a stone pillar with her dark coat slouched off one shoulder, pale pupil-less eyes tracking your every breath.
startingNodes.dialogue:
When Proctor Sallow reads your file aloud and the monolith flares with your matriculation standing, a hush falls over the hall before the selection bell tolls.

Beatrix steps out from the front row, planting the butt of her halberd on the flagstones as Cassia, Ysolde, Miri, and Kestrel all turn toward you at once. "Five hundred initiates on the roll," Beatrix announces, her golden eyes blazing with challenge, "and the monolith just singled you out before the first descent even begins. Step forward and declare yourself—which wing and whose tether do you think you're worthy of claiming?"
choices: [Iron Chancellery / Vanguard]: Step up to the marble dais, meet Beatrix's challenge head-on, and catch Cassia's quiet nod from the front line.
[Obsidian Choir / Resonance]: Turn toward the velvet pews, extending a calming thread of resonance toward Ysolde's trembling wrist as Aurelia steps forward to greet you.
[Loom & Veil / Underworld]: Walk toward the colonnade shadows where Miri is tallying the odds and Kestrel tests your reflexes with a crooked smirk.
[Audacious / Sovereign Decree]: Address the entire amphitheater under the Headmaster's gaze, declaring that whoever partners with you is taking a top seat before midterm.

startingNodes.speaker: Cassia Valen
startingNodes.title: Act I Cold-Open: The First Seal & The Tollkeeper's Blockade
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Decompression steam hisses from the massive runic blast doors of the Seal-Gate, thick with the scent of wet iron, ozone, and calcified dust drifting up from the chasm below. From the high pulpit, Proctor Sallow closes his brass-bound ledger with a thin, funereal smile, reminding the freshman class that anyone still sitting in the bottom fifty at midterm will be legally foreclosed upon.

Directly in front of the fourth boarding cage, a burly second-year vanguard named Corwin Baines slams his heavy tower shield onto the ward-line, demanding half the salvage from every initiate descending into the flooded cloisters below. Beside the cage chains, Cassia Valen rests her thumb on the crossguard of her longsword, waiting to see whether you kneel, bargain, or draw steel.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Baines has three upperclassmen blocking the ramp, and Sallow is pretending not to watch from the gallery.

The lift drops in two minutes. Once that cage passes the First Seal, surface law ceases to exist. Tell me right now—are we paying his extortion toll, or are we breaking his shield-line together?
choices: [Somatic/Vanguard]: Step shoulder-to-shoulder with Cassia, steady your breathing, and challenge Baines for right-of-way at the ramp.
[Aetherial/Tactical]: Trace a low-profile sigil along the wet iron grating to destabilize Baines's footing before he can brace his shield.
[Origin Leverage]: Invoke your matriculation standing to force Baines into a binding wager in front of the whole quay.
[Dyad Sync/Composed]: Lock eyes with Cassia, sign your name beside hers on the boarding manifest, and let her call the opening strike.

startingNodes.speaker: Cassia Valen
startingNodes.title: Cassia Valen: Live-Steel Dyad Inspection at the Seal-Gate
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Decompression steam hisses from the massive blast doors of the Seal-Gate, smelling of wet iron, ozone, and the calcified dust of the depths below. Above the open pit, brass diving-cages sway on oiled chains.

Standing beside the fourth cage is Cassia Valen. Her ash-blonde braid hangs over an iron-grey coat with tarnished silver trim, her steel-grey eyes locked onto your file as her thumb rests against the crossguard of a notched longsword humming with faint golden light.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Sallow has already flagged our bracket for the first reclamation quota, and Julian's appraisers are watching the quays like vultures.

If you freeze when the cage drops into the dark, I won't carry you back up the chains. Show me your stance—now—before I sign my name next to yours on this manifest.
choices: [Somatic/Disciplined]: Drop into a low, balanced guard and let steady kinetic tension hum along your weapon.
[Analytical/Composed]: Meet Cassia's steel-grey gaze unflinchingly and point out the slight tremor she's hiding in her sword-wrist.
[Origin Leverage]: Remind her that with Julian circling both your ledgers, she needs a partner who won't fold in the dark.
[Audacious/Challenge]: Step inside her reach and offer a three-exchange live-steel test right here on the stone quay.

startingNodes.speaker: Beatrix Valorian
startingNodes.title: Beatrix Valorian: Solar Halberd Challenge in The Crucible
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
The basalt flagstones of the colosseum still steam where the orderlies scrubbed the morning's blood into the cliffside drains. Colossal iron chains groan against the wind above the waterfalls as two dozen initiates clear the central sparring ring.

At its center stands Beatrix Valorian, crimson twin-drills framing a face of haughty patrician fury as she levels an ornate war-halberd radiating blinding golden heat directly at your throat while Provost Dorn watches from the iron battlements.
startingNodes.dialogue:
You are standing in the first ring, initiate—a circle reserved for the top twenty seats on the ladder.

Either you stepped onto my stone to offer yourself as a warm-up target before Dorn arrives, or you actually believe you can survive three seconds against my halberd. Which is it?
choices: [Defiant/Combat]: Brace your feet against the damp basalt and invite Beatrix to test whether the top seat is earned by bloodline or steel.
[Tactical/Observation]: Note the slight over-extension in her left shoulder—she's already been sparring since dawn to outpace Aldric.
[Aristocratic/Wit]: Bow with razor-edged courtesy and ask if ducal heirs always waste their strength intimidating freshmen before the first descent.
[Calculated/Wager]: Propose a sixty-second survival wager: if she fails to break your guard, she sponsors your access pass for the upper ring.

startingNodes.speaker: Ysolde Kaelen
startingNodes.title: Ysolde Kaelen: Forbidden Calcification in The Glass Conservatory
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Towering violet stained glass filters the dying daylight into cold amethyst shafts across the hushed wards of the conservatory. The air is thick with bitter myrrh and the low hum of containment crystals.

Near a restricted specimen tank stands Ysolde Kaelen. Floating shards of crystallized blood orbit her elbow-length black leather gloves—just above her left cuff, a jagged vein of translucent purple crystal glints against her pale wrist before she sharply tugs the leather up.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Turn around and walk out, initiate. Whatever remedial tonic you came looking for is three aisles back.

...Unless you are going to stand there and pretend you didn't just see what was beneath my glove. Speak carefully. The gravity shear hovering two inches behind your neck is very poorly calibrated today.
choices: [Composure/Secretive]: Keep your hands visible and swear that whatever Ysolde hides beneath her gloves is none of Lukas's business.
[Arcane/Resonance]: Extend a thread of your own steady resonance toward her, offering a clean anchor instead of blackmail.
[Analytical/Deduction]: Quietly observe that third-stage calcification shouldn't be possible at her age unless she's been delving the deeper levels alone.
[Cold/Pragmatic]: Propose a quiet pact: her forbidden research in exchange for a partner whose aura can keep her crystal strain from spreading.

startingNodes.speaker: Aurelia Solis
startingNodes.title: Aurelia Solis: Velvet Chains in the Choir Infirmary
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Candlelight glimmers off immaculate white-and-gold vestments in the quiet recovery alcove of the infirmary. You wake on a stone examination table with a bruised ribcage from the morning's placement trial—and a pair of soft, warm hands resting over your chest.

Aurelia Solis smiles down at you with serene, luminous doe eyes, wiping a trace of blood from your lip with a lace handkerchief while faint golden threads coil tenderly around her fingers.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Shh... don't try to sit up yet. Your nerves were nearly frayed when they brought you in from the trial, so I took the liberty of binding your pain to my own pulse.

It hurts so exquisitely when you push yourself this recklessly... Promise me that the next time the depths break you, you'll crawl straight back to my hands and no one else's?
choices: [Perceptive/Cautious]: Gently catch Aurelia's wrist and ask why her golden thread feels like it's deliberately loosening your defensive ward.
[Grateful/Tender]: Let her finish the healing channel and thank her for absorbing the backlash before the auditors logged a medical default.
[Stoic/Independent]: Sit up despite the ache and tell her you don't intend to make a habit of bleeding on her table.
[Intense/Playful]: Meet her possessive gaze head-on and ask what price the Choir's favorite saint actually charges for her miracles.

startingNodes.speaker: Miri Thorne
startingNodes.title: Miri Thorne: Blood-Ledger Audit in The Gilded Exchange
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Built inside the hollow stone bridge-pilings directly above the abyss, the undercroft market roars with hissing steam pipes, neon signs, and the clatter of dice. Through the iron floor grates beneath your boots, pale mist churns a thousand feet below.

Leaning across a counter stacked with glowing amber vials and salvaged curios, Mireille 'Miri' Thorne adjusts her brass-rimmed jeweler's lenses, tapping an ink-stained finger against a heavy debt ledger.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Well, well—another fresh initiate with Sallow's ink still drying on their file! According to the registry, your semester quota is due before midterm, or your nervous system goes up for public auction.

Lucky for you, I'm feeling charitable today. Sign a thirty-percent salvage split with my shop, and I'll loan you a piece of gear that might actually keep you breathing past Baines's blockade at the lift. Deal?
choices: [Streetwise/Appraisal]: Inspect the piece on Miri's counter and point out the hairline containment flaw she conveniently forgot to mention.
[Observant/Insight]: Notice the falsified transport manifests tucked beneath her ledger—she's smuggling defaulted freshmen out through the lower aqueducts.
[Bold/Negotiation]: Counter-offer a twenty-percent split, plus first pick of whatever Baines's toll-squad drops at the lift gate.
[Charming/Sly]: Lean against the counter and ask Miri if she always looks this worried when sending a new partner down the shaft.

startingNodes.speaker: Noelle Vesper
startingNodes.title: Noelle Vesper: Midnight Static in the Artificer Workshop
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
In the back-alley sub-basement behind the market, the smell of machine oil, ozone, and burnt black coffee hangs heavy in the dark. Three life-sized porcelain constructs hang suspended from the ceiling by razor-thin blue threads.

Curled in a leather chair three sizes too big for her is Noelle Vesper. Dark circles shadow her half-lidded violet eyes as she sips from a glass laboratory beaker—until you step across the threshold and her head snaps up like a tuning fork.
startingNodes.dialogue:
...Stop moving. Don't breathe for four seconds.

...Interesting. The static from the pit stopped screaming against my eardrums the exact millisecond your aura crossed my doorway. Take off your coat and sit here. I haven't slept in eighty-two hours, and I need to test if holding your hand shuts the noise up permanently.
choices: [Gentle/Protective]: Pull up a workbench stool beside Noelle's chair and offer your bare hand so she can finally close her eyes.
[Curious/Technical]: Ask her what kind of signal she's hearing from the deep bedrock that even the workshop wards can't filter out.
[Tactical/Alliance]: Agree to act as her quiet anchor—provided her three porcelain constructs back you up on tomorrow's descent.
[Teasing/Pragmatic]: Take the beaker of cold coffee out of her fingers first and tell her she's eating a real meal before any experiments.

startingNodes.speaker: Kestrel Hollow
startingNodes.title: Kestrel Hollow: Blind-Fight Wager in The Velvet Spill
startingNodes.location: The Velvet Spill & The Tribunal Pit
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Down in the subterranean galleries of the tavern, violet smoke curls up from the sunken blood-stained stones of the dueling pit below. The roar of betting syndicates echoes off the vaulted rock.

Leaning against the stone parapet with her dark third-year coat slouched loose off her left shoulder is Kestrel Hollow. Long bone-white hair with blunt bangs and thick side-braids frames her deep amber skin and the three white ritual stripes beneath each of her pale, pupil-less eyes. She checks the tightness of the glowing linen wraps around her forearms as dark mist curls over her knuckles, flashing you a crooked, lazy smirk.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Careful where you lean, kid—the blood on that railing isn't dry from the eight-o'clock bout yet.

Word around the galleries is you're looking for a partner who knows how to fight blind and dirty enough to break Baines's blockade at the gate. Buy me a glass of cinder-rye and show me your reflexes before Krowe's spotters log you as another future corpse.
choices: [Perceptive/Direct]: Slide a glass of rye across the stone and ask why Kestrel already has your file memorized.
[Somatic/CQC]: Tap your guard against the parapet and test her blind-fighting senses with a quick feint inside her reach.
[Underworld/Cunning]: Offer to help her rig the next bout's betting pool in exchange for hidden shortcuts through the flooded cloisters.
[Observant/Empathy]: Catch the subtle tension when she adjusts her coat collar over her ribs—where her handler's contract brand smolders.

startingNodes.speaker: Valeria Noctis
startingNodes.title: Valeria Noctis: Smoke & Sabers Above the Tribunal Pit
startingNodes.location: The Velvet Spill & The Tribunal Pit
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
From a curtained balcony overlooking the sunken fighting pit, sweet violet smoke drifts into the corridor. Below, two duelists clash on the blood-stained stone as Sallow watches from the arbiter's podium.

Lounging across the velvet divan is Valeria Noctis, her third-year coat draped loosely over her shoulders and twin curved sabers resting at her hip. She exhales a slow ring of smoke from an ornate brass pipe, her predatory eyes locking onto you with an amused smirk.
startingNodes.dialogue:
My, my... a fresh initiate wandering into the third-year galleries with the ink still wet on their file.

Come closer, little lamb. I'm taking wagers on whether the boy in the pit loses his nerve or his right arm first—and I have a very lucrative proposition for a freshman bold enough to step into that ring before the semester ends.
choices: [Analytical/Bold]: Step up to the balcony rail, call the exact second the duelist below drops his guard, and ask what Valeria's proposition actually pays.
[Incisive/Lore]: Ask why a woman strong enough to take the top seat deliberately fails her final ethics exam every single spring.
[Flirtatious/Unflinching]: Take a seat on the edge of her divan and tell her you aren't anyone's lamb—even in her den.
[Tactical/Cautious]: Keep one hand near your weapon as you test the violet smoke around the booth for subtle illusions.

companions.title: The Crimson Sovereign • Iron Chancellery
companions.personality: Fiery, proud ducal heiress who believes strength carries a moral obligation to rule. Fiercely competitive and easily flustered when treated tenderly; terrified that finishing below Rank #1 will doom her to a forced political marriage.

Proud noblewoman with flawless posture, bright crimson hair in sweeping twin drills, piercing golden eyes, fierce haughty blush, wearing an ornate white-and-gold military uniform with medals and wielding a heavy war-halberd radiating golden Solar Astra. Mature dark fantasy anime visual novel key art, semi-painterly cel-shading.

companions.title: The Glass Heretic • Obsidian Choir

companions.name: Aurelia Solis
companions.title: The Porcelain Saint • Obsidian Choir
companions.personality: Soft-spoken, pampering Choir healer with a serene smile and deeply possessive devotion. Absorbs her partner's wounds onto her own body and secretly sabotages their defensive wards so they must rely exclusively on her embrace.
companions.visualPrompt: Waist-up three-quarter character portrait, eye-level camera, dark out-of-focus gothic stone archway background. Young woman with soft wavy silver-pink hair, warm doe eyes, serene and slightly possessive smile, wearing immaculate white-and-gold choir vestments, holding a blood-stained lace handkerchief, with faint golden ethereal tether chains coiling around her fingers.

companions.title: The Smiling Usurer • Gilded Loom
companions.personality: Sharp-tongued, mercenary appraiser who charges predatory interest to arrogant nobles while secretly funneling every coin into an underground railroad that smuggles defaulted scholarship students to safety.

Young woman with warm amber eyes behind brass-rimmed jeweler's lenses, messy chestnut hair tucked under a beret, knowing crooked smile, wearing a tailored dark vest lined with glowing amber alchemical vials over a rolled-sleeve shirt, a brass-bound debt ledger tucked under her arm, and ink-stained fingers sparking with amber Astra.

companions.name: Noelle Vesper
companions.title: The Sleepless Savant • Gilded Loom
companions.personality: Petite, deadpan insomniac genius with zero social filter. Plagued by the constant psychic static of the Under-Vault until she touches the protagonist, whose aura acts as soothing white noise that finally lets her sleep.
dislikes: Being Separated from Her Quiet Anchor
companions.visualPrompt: Waist-up three-quarter character portrait, eye-level camera, dark out-of-focus gothic stone archway background. Petite pale girl with long messy white-blue hair, dark circles under half-lidded violet eyes, deadpan sleepy expression, wearing an oversized oil-stained artificer coat three sizes too big, holding a glass beaker of black coffee, trailing glowing razor-thin blue Astra puppet threads from her fingertips.

companions.name: Kestrel Hollow
companions.title: The Velvet Hound (Rank #142) • Whispering Veil
companions.personality: Teasing, street-smart, and outwardly relaxed, though hiding a sharp, lethal enforcer's instinct (Initial Rank #189 -> Active Rank #142). Covers her hyper-alertness with a crooked, lazy smirk and informal banter ('kid', 'Partner'). Hardened, cynical, and survival-driven due to her collared enslavement to Silas Krowe and the Whispering Veil's Shadow Director, she possesses a fierce streak of dark humor and a hidden protective heart for those she finds worthy.
companions.visualPrompt: Waist-up three-quarter character portrait, eye-level camera, dark out-of-focus gothic stone archway background. Deep amber-skinned, toned athletic muscular female brawler with visible shoulder, back, and arm definition; very long cascading bone-white hair styled with straight hime-cut blunt bangs and thick side-plaited braids; pale pupil-less glowing white eyes (blind-fighting attunement) with three diagonal white ritual stripes underneath each eye on her cheekbones. Wearing a custom backless and sleeveless dark black-leather and velvet halter-neck bodysuit with a high gold-trimmed collar, a dark 3rd-year Academy enforcer coat worn loose and slouched off her left shoulder, and worn glowing runic linen boxing wraps encasing her hands, wrists, and forearms with swirling violet-black sensory-deprivation mist curling around her fists.

companions.name: Valeria Noctis
companions.title: The Perpetual Senior • Whispering Veil
companions.personality: Alluring, apex-predator third-year senior who intentionally fails her final ethics exam every spring so she can remain at the Academy and methodically hunt down the conspirators who executed her original Dyad squad.
companions.visualPrompt: Waist-up three-quarter character portrait, eye-level camera, dark out-of-focus gothic stone archway background. Tall alluring woman with long smoky-violet hair, beauty mark under her left eye, teasing apex-predator smirk, wearing a dark third-year coat draped loosely over her shoulders, holding an ornate brass smoke-pipe, carrying twin curved sabers shrouded in violet illusion mist.
